description: This PHP source file defines the Date class providing utilities for handling dates and times within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including conversions between PHP DateTime objects and Excel serial date formats, timezone management, and date format recognition.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for date and time conversions, validation, and formatting within the PhpSpreadsheet library, supporting different calendar bases, timezones, and Excel date serial formats.

methods.name: setExcelCalendar
methods.description: Sets the base calendar year used for date calculations, supporting Windows 1900 or Mac 1904 systems.

methods.name: getExcelCalendar
methods.description: Returns the current calendar base year used for date calculations.

methods.name: setDefaultTimezone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone for date/time conversions within the library.

methods.name: getDefaultTimezone
methods.description: Returns the default timezone object, defaulting to UTC if not explicitly set.

methods.name: getDefaultOrLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the default timezone or the local timezone if not set.

methods.name: getDefaultTimezoneOrNull
methods.description: Returns the default timezone or null if not set.

methods.name: validateTimeZone
methods.description: Validates and converts a given timezone to a DateTimeZone object, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: convertIsoDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO-8601 date string to an Excel serial date number.

methods.name: excelToDateTimeObject
methods.description: Converts an Excel serialized date number to a PHP DateTime object, considering the calendar and timezone.

methods.name: excelToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts an Excel date serial number to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: PHPToExcel
methods.description: Converts PHP DateTime objects, timestamps, or date strings to Excel serialized date numbers.

methods.name: dateTimeToExcel
methods.description: Converts a PHP DateTime object to an Excel serialized date number.

methods.name: timestampToExcel
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to an Excel serialized date number.

methods.name: formattedPHPToExcel
methods.description: Creates an Excel serial date number from individual date components (Y, m, d, H, i, s).

methods.name: isDateTime
methods.description: Determines if a cell contains a date/time value based on its number format.

methods.name: isDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Checks if a number format code corresponds to a date/time format.

methods.name: isDateTimeFormatCode
methods.description: Analyzes a format code string to determine if it is a date/time format.

methods.name: stringToExcel
methods.description: Converts a date string to an Excel serial number if in a valid format.

methods.name: monthStringToNumber
methods.description: Converts a month name or abbreviation to its numeric month value.

methods.name: dayStringToNumber
methods.description: Removes ordinal suffix from a day string and returns the numeric value.

methods.name: dateTimeFromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a PHP DateTime object from a Unix timestamp, with optional timezone.

methods.name: formattedDateTimeFromTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a Unix timestamp into a string using a specified date format and optional timezone.
